description: A live Model switch between turns: after the first turn on claude-opus-5-5 the host sends set_model claude-sonnet-5-5 (the driver awaits query.setModel), then the next prompt. The main agent's next request runs on Sonnet, so the adapter sends model_changed before that request's text, and the result reports each Model's usage separately. Synthesised from the Agent SDK 0.3.300 message types (paired with Claude Code 2.1.300), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture made with SWITCHYARD_RECORD_DIR (see sidecar/README.md).
